title: Learning diverse attacks on large language models for robust red-teaming and safety tuning
abstract: arXiv:2405.18540v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Red-teaming, or identifying prompts that elicit harmful responses, is a critical step in ensuring the safe and responsible deployment of large language models (LLMs). Developing effective protection against many modes of attack prompts requires discovering diverse attacks. Automated red-teaming typically uses reinforcement learning to fine-tune an attacker language model to generate prompts that elicit undesirable responses from a target LLM, as measured, for example, by an auxiliary toxicity classifier. We show that even with explicit regularization to favor novelty and diversity, existing approaches suffer from mode collapse or fail to generate effective attacks. As a flexible and probabilistically principled alternative, we propose to use GFlowNet fine-tuning, followed by a secondary smoothing phase, to train the attacker model to generate diverse and effective attack prompts. translated_title: 学习对大型语言模型的多样化攻击以实现鲁棒的红队测试与安全调优
translated_abstract: 红队测试（即识别能引发有害回应的提示词）是确保大型语言模型（LLM）安全、负责任部署的关键步骤。要针对多种攻击模式开发有效的防护，就需要发现多样化的攻击。自动化红队测试通常使用强化学习来微调一个攻击者语言模型，使其生成能从目标LLM引发不良回应的提示词，例如通过辅助毒性分类器来衡量。我们表明，即使采用偏向新颖性和多样性的显式正则化，现有方法仍会出现模式坍塌或无法生成有效攻击的问题。作为一种灵活且具有概率论原理的替代方案，我们提出使用GFlowNet微调，随后进行二次平滑阶段，来训练攻击者模型生成多样且有效的攻击提示词。我们发现，我们方法生成的攻击是……
tldr: 该论文提出使用GFlowNet微调加二次平滑来训练攻击者模型，克服现有自动化红队测试中的模式坍塌问题，从而生成多样且有效的攻击提示词，以提升大型语言模型的安全调优效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GFlowNet fine-tuning with a secondary smoothing phase to train attacker models that generate diverse and effective attack prompts, overcoming mode collapse in automated red-teaming for robust LLM safety tuning.
